The Autonomous Terminal
that really executes code.

No mandatory hosted tier. No telemetry lock. MIT licensed.
Your machine. Your API keys. Your local files. Your rules.

What It Does

Built for developers who value sovereignty.

Every capability designed from scratch to keep you in control of your tools, your data, and your code.

Runs on Your Machine

Native on macOS, Windows, or Linux. Connect hosted, OpenRouter, or local Ollama models. Your code and files never leave your workstation.

WhatsApp Remote Shell

Execute terminal commands, open applications, and monitor build outputs straight from your phone over WhatsApp. Zero port forwarding required.

Telegram Bot Gateway

Review staged code diffs and approve terminal plans using intuitive Telegram inline keyboards and real-time status updates.

Safe Virtual Staging

Every generated edit is held in memory as a unified diff. Inspect before applying; never worry about an agent corrupting your project files.

OpenRouter & Model Freedom

Seamlessly switch between Claude 3.5 Sonnet, GPT-4o, DeepSeek-V3, or local Llama instances without rewriting a single agent tool.

Single Binary CLI Suite

Installed globally in one step. Run interactive terminals, headless background daemons, or multi-agent queues with clean CLI flags.

Core Capabilities & Workflow

System Architecture: How It Works

Four synchronized operational modes powered by the Vercel AI SDK, OpenRouter LLMs, Baileys WhatsApp sockets, and Telegraf.

1. Agentic Terminal Mode

Autonomous AI pairing terminal. Executes tool loops, reads files, discovers structure, stages file edits in virtual memory, and presents unified diffs for interactive user approval.

pcbrew start

Key Subsystems & Safeguards

Interactive REPL with slash command palette (/config, /agent, /plan, /ask, /cmd, /sysinfo)
Zero-mutation safety layer: AI writes to an in-memory staging overlay first
Unified colored diff viewer before any byte touches your filesystem
Autonomous directory exploration and codebase structural analysis

Remote Telemetry & Operations

Telegram Bot: Setup & Attach Guide

Control your local development workspace, review staged diffs, and spawn AI agents directly from your mobile Telegram app.

1

Create Bot with @BotFather

Open the Telegram app and search for @BotFather. Send the command /newbot, give it a name and username (e.g. my_pcbrew_bot). BotFather will reply with your unique API Token.

Format: 7123456789:AAHq_xyzABC...Keep Secret!
2

Get Your Telegram User ID (Auth Protection)

Search for @userinfobot on Telegram and send any message. It will reply with your numerical Id (e.g. 123456789).

Crucial Safeguard: PC Brew checks every incoming Telegram command against this ID. Anyone else messaging your bot will be rejected immediately.
3

Add Variables & Launch Gateway

# Add to config or run pcbrew setup
TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN=7123456789:AAHq_xyzABC...
TELEGRAM_OWNER_ID=123456789

Remote Laptop Controller

WhatsApp Integration: Operate Laptop via Chat

Powered by the Baileys library. Turns your private WhatsApp into a secure remote control console for executing terminal commands, querying system hardware, and driving AI agents on your laptop.

1

Set Your Phone Number in Configuration

Add your mobile phone number with your international country code (no leading plus sign or dashes):

WHATSAPP_OWNER_NUMBER=919876543210

Example: For India (+91) with number 9876543210, use 919876543210. For US (+1), use 1XXXXXXXXXX.

2

Launch Mode & Scan Terminal QR Code

Run pcbrew whatsapp. A dynamic QR code will render directly in your terminal.

📱 On your phone:
Open WhatsApp ➔ Settings ➔ Linked Devices ➔ Link a Device
Point your phone camera at the terminal QR code to link!
Session keys are saved locally in .whatsapp_auth/. You only scan once!
3

Pairing Fallback: /claim Command

If your phone account connects via multiple device JIDs, simply message /claim or /auth from WhatsApp. The bot dynamically authorizes your session as the master laptop operator.

Configuration Tool

Environment Generator: Any LLM Provider

PC Brew supports any major LLM key: OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or Google Gemini. Select your provider, enter your keys, and generate a ready-to-use configuration.

Provider & Key Parameters
Get free or paid key at openrouter.ai/keys
Generated Configuration Preview
# Active Provider: OpenRouter
AI_PROVIDER=openrouter
OPENROUTER_API_KEY=sk-or-v1-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
OPENROUTER_DEFAULT_MODEL=openrouter/free

# Telegram Integration (Optional)
TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN=
TELEGRAM_OWNER_ID=

# WhatsApp Laptop Controller (Optional: Phone number with country code, no +)
WHATSAPP_OWNER_NUMBER=

# Web Search & Scraping (Optional for Firecrawl)
FIRECRAWL_API_KEY=
💡 Usage: Run pcbrew setup to configure interactively in your terminal, or save this as .env in your root directory.

Governance

Independent Stewardship

PCBREW is an independent open-source initiative. The core repository is MIT licensed, forever free, with zero proprietary enterprise upsells.

Privacy & Telemetry

Zero Uninvited Tracking

By default, installs send nothing to remote servers. All LLM calls route strictly to your configured API endpoints. No analytics, no prompt harvesting.

Extensibility

Hackable by Design

Built using standard Bun scripts, modular TypeScript classes, and clean CLI flags. Add your own tool plugins or custom chat bridges in minutes.

Ecosystem Backers & Donors

Supported by independent contributors, developer donors, and open source infrastructure partners.
